_about: Find a place by real clues, not by a mark (#27; src/core/clues.js; docs/WORLD.md, "Finding Trâu Sơn"). The hero has never seen the place. A find: flag (set when the hero first stands in the area), frame and area (the cells of the frame of the place: x0, y0, x1, y1), toward (the way of the arrow of the quest before the hero finds the place: [1, 0] is east, toward the sunrise), way (the people on the way: east of the column x of the frame), path (the road of the way, the road east of data/world/land-giong.json: its two ends; before the find, the mark of the quest is on this road ahead of the hero, and the road ends in the area, #56), people (the people who stand on the road and greet the hero with the clues: id, at (the part of the road, 0 to 1), look), clues (in order, each from another person who greets the hero on the way, once, when the quest leads to the place), and wrong (a person at a wrong place says why it is not the place). Each line has its source. No line gives or takes anything: the world answers, with no fail and no score.

clues.source: Đại Nam nhất thống chí: "Núi Trâu Sơn còn gọi là núi Vũ Ninh ở phía Đông huyện Quế Dương 12 dặm" (east of the district of Quế Dương). Quoted in https://huvi.wordpress.com/2019/03/08/nhung-dieu-moi-biet-ve-ma-co-tien-o-chau-son/
Đại Nam nhất thống chí: "núi non liên tiếp kéo dài" (hills one after another, in a long line). Quoted in https://huvi.wordpress.com/2019/03/08/nhung-dieu-moi-biet-ve-ma-co-tien-o-chau-son/

wrong.source: The fine heights (data/geo/heights/N21E106.bin): Núi Dạm is one compact hill with a top of 130 m at 106.10 E, 21.145 N; the hills near Châu Cầu are a line about 4 km long, from north-west to south-east, with tops of 51 to 71 m, at 106.215 to 106.25 E.
